nodes.summary: `KKLHypercontractive p 0` holds trivially, since total influence is nonnegative.
nodes.title: KKL inequality with constant 0 holds trivially

nodes.summary: Kahn–Kalai–Linial inequality, maximal-influence form (J. Kahn, G. Kalai, N. Linial, *The influence of variables on Boolean functions*, FOCS 1988): under `KKLHypercontractive p c`, `c · Var(φ) · log (1 / δ) ≤ |E| · δ` with `δ = maxₑ Infₑ(φ)`, so `δ` is at least of order `Var(φ) · log |E| / |E|`.
nodes.title: Kahn–Kalai–Linial inequality

nodes.summary: Kahn–Kalai–Linial inequality, total-influence form (J. Kahn, G. Kalai, N. Linial, *The influence of variables on Boolean functions*, FOCS 1988): under `KKLHypercontractive p c`, `c · Var(φ) · log (1 / maxₑ Infₑ(φ)) ≤ ∑ₑ Infₑ(φ)`.
nodes.title: Kahn–Kalai–Linial inequality

nodes.summary: The KKL inequality with constant `c` for the Bernoulli(`p`) product measure: for every finite nonempty index type `E` and every Boolean function `φ` on `{0, 1}^E`, `c · Var(φ) · log (1 / maxₑ Infₑ(φ)) ≤ ∑ₑ Infₑ(φ)`, with `Infₑ(φ)` the probability that `e` is pivotal.
nodes.title: KKL inequality with constant $c$ for the $p$-biased measure
